{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for severe patients
severe_patients = data[data['severity'] == 'severe']

# Filter out QC-failed baseline values (-999)
valid_severe = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check number of valid severe patients
print(f"Number of severe patients with valid baseline: {len(valid_severe)}")

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline = valid_severe['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) for severe patients: {mean_baseline}")

# Confirm the value is in ng/mL
print("Units of biomarker_baseline: ng/mL (per documentation, no correction needed)")"}
